python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,hashlib,io,json,os,pathlib,platform,subprocess,tarfile,time
assert platform.system()=='Linux' and platform.machine()=='x86_64' and os.geteuid()!=0
projects=pathlib.Path.home()/'Projects';assert projects.resolve()==projects and projects.is_dir()
stat=os.statvfs(projects);assert not stat.f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY and stat.f_bavail*stat.f_frsize>=4*1024**3 and os.access(projects,os.W_OK|os.X_OK)
base=projects/'shards-managed-events-official-current-v1';base.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=False)
budget={'cpus':2,'memory_bytes':2*1024**3,'disk_bytes':4*1024**3,'timeout_s':600,'jobs':2,'startup_s':10,'request_s':10,'cleanup_s':15,'deadline_monotonic':time.monotonic()+600}
with (base/'budget.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(budget,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
payload=base64.b64decode('',validate=True);assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()=='c5886d1a487158ecbb9ac670a1c857fe50a3b2c4f71ae52f6f8b4ea639192ede'
source=base/'source';source.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
with (base/'source.tar.xz').open('xb') as f:f.write(payload)
expected={'oracle/go.mod': {'bytes': 486, 'sha256': '244a158ab3df46213335e5e95e1ec7b790745dee596520e2721a032aef0a8312'}, 'oracle/go.sum': {'bytes': 3691, 'sha256': '84a3ae9a5eff3702ce4dfca65ce3f3cb5e5cc9c96519f61d06ce1904b4d9e087'}, 'oracle/main.go': {'bytes': 8649, 'sha256': 'f68d26fad446e8fe0a78517fbe9d7e8296775368da2b1bbf2829a3108925012d'}, 'oracle/main_test.go': {'bytes': 5300, 'sha256': 'cf2d9f451117ebad413caec8a716fb2f9db1512f06b47e4ee2a7e6092dc50195'}, 'oracle/upstream.json': {'bytes': 1586, 'sha256': 'fcbfaab8904b2706f4ff4f71abb70a9e9976b687e4050c90b8f4aa69cd9e7c0a'}, 'collector-http.py': {'bytes': 6862, 'sha256': 'feff897fd072117d0f066797ac27e1b8e40ba0c98709b48bd8ed8828dd9c7931'}}
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(payload),mode='r:xz') as t:
 members=t.getmembers();assert len(members)==len({m.name for m in members})==len(expected)==6
 for member in members:
  p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name);assert member.isfile() and not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts
  data=t.extractfile(member).read();assert len(data)==expected[member.name]['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==expected[member.name]['sha256']
  path=source/p;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  with path.open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
controllers=base64.b64decode('',validate=True);assert hashlib.sha256(controllers).hexdigest()=='8313f5616da0b899740baeb0cda05b1093b955bd9dbc21da6a82e4d93cc43e31'
expected={'run.py': 'be8b52fec912a1cb994643bdedd10ed4d417621e6156c60479ffcc65572c407b', 'observe-collector.py': '6f0fbf6acf6e9882ae52aa67c381d75cfd7c6951327dafd583222efec8d0cea6'}
with (base/'controllers.tar.xz').open('xb') as f:f.write(controllers)
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(controllers),mode='r:xz') as t:
 members=t.getmembers();assert len(members)==len({m.name for m in members})==len(expected)==2
 for member in members:
  assert member.isfile() and member.name in expected
  data=t.extractfile(member).read();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==expected[member.name]
  with (base/member.name).open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
print(json.dumps({'phase':'preparation','base':str(base),'budget':budget,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'controller_hashes':expected,'test_or_collector_calls':0}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(subprocess.run(['python3','run.py','prepare'],cwd=base,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=False).returncode)
